review_candidates.title: Junior Administration, Event Operations & Partnership Coordinator
review_candidates.description: Junior Administration, Event Operations & Partnership Coordinator Wheel and Meal cerca una figura junior per supportare la gestione amministrativa e coordinare il Partner Program. Queste saranno le due responsabilità quotidiane del ruolo. Quando un evento richiederà la presenza di un nostro referente sul posto, andrai in trasferta per seguire le operazioni di Wheel and Meal, anche in autonomia. Ci occupiamo di forniture alimentari e logistica per eventi in Italia e all’estero, tra cui i Gran Premi di Formula 1 e MotoGP. Con il Partner Program aiutiamo le aziende food & beverage a sviluppare relazioni commerciali con buyer, distributori e operatori del foodservice e a realizzare attività di comunicazione e promozione legate agli eventi. Supporto alla gestione amministrativa Lavorerai a fianco del team amministrativo per seguire le pratiche aziendali e quelle legate alle partnership. Ti occuperai di: * Raccogliere e verificare anagrafiche, dati di fatturazione, contratti firmati e documenti. * Aggiornare i prospetti relativi a fatturazione, acconti, saldi e pagamenti, in collaborazione con i colleghi. * Seguire le scadenze e la raccolta dei documenti mancanti, contattando i referenti e segnalando per tempo le pratiche che richiedono attenzione. Coordinamento del Partner Program Sarai il punto di riferimento operativo per le aziende partner e per i colleghi coinvolti nel progetto. Ti occuperai di: * Tenere aggiornato il piano di lavoro di ogni partner e seguire gli impegni presi, le scadenze e le attività da completare. * Organizzare incontri e presentazioni a buyer e distributori, raccogliere cataloghi e materiali e seguire i contatti dopo gli appuntamenti. * Coordinare con i team interni le attività concordate con ciascuna azienda, tra cui newsletter, contenuti social, biglietti, distribuzione di prodotti nel paddock e presenza sulla piattaforma Wheel and Meal. Trasferte e operazioni durante gli eventi Le trasferte dipenderanno dalle esigenze operative. Potranno riguardare Formula 1, MotoGP e qualsiasi altro evento in cui sia necessario un referente Wheel and Meal sul posto, in Italia o all’estero, anche nei fine settimana. Prima della partenza contribuirai a preparare il piano operativo e a verificare orari, contatti e istruzioni di consegna. Durante l’evento seguirai le consegne e le attività sul posto, in contatto con fornitori, trasportatori e referenti locali. Potrà capitare di viaggiare da solo e di essere l’unico referente Wheel and Meal presente all’evento. Se una consegna slitta o il programma cambia all’ultimo momento, dovrai capire rapidamente cosa è successo, individuare una soluzione praticabile e aggiornare il team. Requisiti indispensabili * Ottima conoscenza dell’inglese, in particolare nella comprensione orale e nel parlato. Devi riuscire a gestire telefonate e conversazioni di lavoro, comprendere indicazioni operative e spiegare con chiarezza cosa serve, anche sotto pressione. * Piena autonomia nel viaggiare. Devi saper gestire spostamenti, coincidenze e cambi di programma anche da solo, lontano da casa e all’estero. * Spiccata capacità di risolvere problemi sul campo. Ci aspettiamo che tu sappia mantenere la calma, valutare le priorità e prendere l’iniziativa anche senza colleghi sul posto, coinvolgendo il team quando serve una decisione condivisa. * Precisione e affidabilità nel lavoro quotidiano. Dovrai seguire documenti, scadenze e attività di più aziende in parallelo, con dimestichezza nell’uso di fogli di calcolo e strumenti di lavoro condivisi. Il ruolo è junior e prevede un affiancamento iniziale sui processi di Wheel and Meal. Valutiamo anche candidature alla prima esperienza. Uno stage o un’esperienza in amministrazione, back office commerciale, logistica o organizzazione di eventi è apprezzato. Per candidarti, invia il tuo CV tramite LinkedIn.

We invite you to join the Hexcel team at various manufacturing sites, sales offices, and R&D centers around the globe. Become a part of the “strength within.” Hexcel is currently seeking an International Tax Manager for our Stamford, CT headquarters (hybrid on-site - 3 days in the office/2 days at home). This position reports to the Director of International Tax and offers the opportunity to contribute to a broad range of international tax activities, including tax provision, compliance, transfer pricing, audit defense, and planning. The International Tax Manager will monitor changes in U.S. and international tax laws, assess their potential impact on Hexcel, and help identify opportunities while proactively managing future tax exposures. The successful candidate will combine strong international tax technical knowledge with a collaborative, team-oriented working style, the ability to independently manage priorities, and a demonstrated continuous improvement mindset. The selected individual will be responsible for but not limited to the following obligations: Lead quarterly and annual international tax provision activities for non-U.S. entities under ASC 740. Manage U.S. international tax compliance, including Forms 5471, 8858, 8865 and 1118, and related GILTI, FDII, Subpart F, foreign tax credit, and Section 163(j) calculations. Lead OECD Pillar Two modeling, compliance, Safe Harbor analysis, and related filings. Coordinate foreign tax compliance and local-country filing requirements. Manage transfer pricing compliance, including Local Files, Master Files, CbCR, and intercompany service and royalty calculations. Support international tax planning, cash repatriation, intercompany financing, and tax audits. Manage and develop junior staff and coordinate work with external advisors. Maintain strong tax processes and controls and identify opportunities to improve efficiency through process and technology enhancements. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Accounting required; CPA and/or master’s degree in Taxation preferred. 4–6+ years of international tax experience in Big Four public accounting, a multinational corporate tax department, or a combination of both. Strong working knowledge of U.S. international tax compliance, ASC 740, GILTI, FDII, Subpart F, foreign tax credits, and related international tax matters. Hands-on experience with international tax modeling tools and tax compliance/provision software such as ONESOURCE, Corptax, or comparable platforms. Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with the ability to independently manage multiple priorities. Experience with OneStream is a plus. Summary pay range: $160,000 - $195,000 annual salary. At Hexcel, we strive to deliver a Total Rewards package that will attract, engage and retain the top talent. Elements of the Total Rewards package include competitive base pay and variable compensation opportunities. Hexcel also provides eligible employees with an opportunity to enroll in a variety of benefit programs, generally including health insurance, flexible spending accounts, health savings accounts, retirement savings plans, life and disability insurance programs, and a number of programs that provide for both paid and unpaid time away from work. The specific programs and options available to any given employee may vary depending on eligibility factors such as geographic location, date of hire, and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements. Please note that the salary information shown above represents the wage range set at the time of posting. Salaries may ultimately be based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations that arise after posting. Eligible candidates must be a: U.S. citizen, U.S. national, person lawfully admitted for permanent residence, temporary resident under sections 210(a) or 245(A) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, person admitted in refugee status, or person granted asylum. Hexcel (NYSE: HXL) is a global leader in advanced composites technology, a leading producer of carbon fiber, and the world leader in honeycomb manufacturing for the commercial aerospace industry. Hexcel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected class.

Nous développons une solution de transport aérien pour soutenir le développement économique des territoires enclavés et réduire significativement l’empreinte environnementale du transport cargo. FLYING WHALES conçoit en consortium, construira sur trois continents, et exploitera dans le monde une flotte de dirigeables, les LCA60T capables de charger et décharger en vol stationnaire jusqu’à 60 tonnes de charge (bois, pales d’éolienne, conteneurs, hôpital mobile, etc.) avec une empreinte environnementale particulièrement faible. Ce système de transport est unique au monde. FLYING WHALES développe aussi FLYING WHALES SERVICES, la société d’opération de cette flotte, qui doit rassembler les compétences d’une compagnie aérienne et d’une société aéroportuaire. Chez FLYING WHALES, nous portons donc une vision très ambitieuse qui rassemble aujourd’hui plus de 200 pionniers, un actionnariat international puissant, et une cinquantaine d’entreprises partenaires. Des pionniers du 21è siècle, femmes et hommes, qui apportent tous les jours leur envie, leur passion et leur savoir-faire pour donner naissance à une nouvelle solution de transport, mais aussi à une idée. L’idée que les sociétés doivent pouvoir continuer à créer des liens pour se développer. C’est la mission que s’est donnée FLYING WHALES : désenclaver des régions isolées dans le monde tout en participant à la réduction des émissions de CO2 et des infrastructures de transport. Vous Souhaitez Nous Aider à Écrire L’une Des Pages De L’histoire De L’aéronautique Et Du Développement Économique Des Territoires Isolés ? Voici Le Pionnier Que Nous Recherchons QUI RECHERCHONS NOUS ? Dans le cadre de notre croissance organique en France et à l’international, nous recrutons un INGÉNIEUR STACK-UP & TOLÉRANCEMENT (H/F). Le Département Structure a la charge du développement des structures du dirigeable LCA60T. Le département regroupe notamment des fonctions de conception et de calcul mécanique. Mission Vos Missions Au sein du Département Structure, vous interviendrez sur la définition, l’analyse et la maîtrise des chaînes de côtes et des tolérances de la structure du LCA60T et de ses interfaces. Dans Ce Cadre, Votre Rôle Consistera à Préparer et réaliser les chaînes de côtes et analyses de tolérances de la structure du LCA60T et de ses interfaces. Réaliser des analyses GD&T avancées, définir les interfaces et établir les documents ICD (Interface Control Documents). Planifier, organiser et prioriser les différents sujets liés aux chaînes de côtes du LCA60T. Participer à l’organisation et à la planification des activités de conception structure liées aux tolérances. Participer à l’organisation et au développement des méthodes et outils de conception associés au tolérancement. Supporter les équipes multidisciplinaires responsables des lots de travaux internes et externes sur les problématiques de tolérancement. Supporter l’équipe Design Structure dans la conception des différents composants. Assurer la bonne traçabilité des analyses réalisées. Profil Votre Parcours BAC +5, diplôme d’Ingénieur ou Master équivalent dans le domaine aéronautique ou mécanique. Au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans la conception mécanique et/ou l’analyse de chaînes de côtes. Une expérience préalable dans le secteur aéronautique est requise. Une expérience en gestion de projet constitue un atout. Vos Compétences Maîtrise de l’analyse de chaînes de côtes selon ASME Y14.5 ou normes ISO GD&T équivalentes. Bonne maîtrise du GD&T – Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing. Expérience dans le calcul de chaînes de côtes appliqué aux structures principales aéronautiques. Conception mécanique et maîtrise des assemblages mécaniques. Élaboration et préparation de dessins mécaniques sur outils CAD 2D et/ou 3D. Maîtrise de CATIA V5, notamment Part Design, Generative Shape Design et Functional Tolerancing & Annotation. La connaissance de CATIA V6 / 3DEXPERIENCE est un plus. La maîtrise d’un logiciel spécialisé de chaînes de côtes tel que 3DCS ou MECAmaster est un plus. Connaissance de la conception de structures aéronautiques. Connaissance de l’EBOM et des pièces standards utilisées dans l’industrie aéronautique. Vos Qualités Vous êtes créatif, curieux Vous appréciez les environnements techniques complexes et multidisciplinaires. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et êtes un bon communicant. Vous êtes organisé Anglais et français courants. Ce Que Nous Offrons Un intéressement au capital Une perspective d’évolution rapide dans une entreprise en croissance La possibilité de télétravailler Une salle de sport sur le lieu de travail Déroulement Des Entretiens Un entretien avec Alexandra, Talent Acquisition. Un entretien avec Clayton, Design Stack-Up Engineer. Un entretien avec Swann, Head of Structure. Informations Pratiques Contrat : CDI Lieu de travail : Suresnes – 92 Poste disponible : Dès que possible Département : Structure Point de contact : www.flying-whales.com Référence : STACK-UP – 2026 Référence de l'offre : g926w8onsb

review_candidates.title: Finance Director
review_candidates.description: Amentum is a global leader in advanced engineering and innovative technology solutions, trusted by the United States and its allies to address their most significant and complex challenges in science, security and sustainability. Our people apply undaunted curiosity, relentless ambition and boundless imagination to challenge convention and drive progress. Our commitments are underpinned by the belief that safety, collaboration and well-being are integral to success. Headquartered in Chantilly, Virginia, we have approximately 50,000 employees in more than 70 countries across all 7 continents. Are you seeking a career that offers a healthy work-life balance, a friendly company culture, and engagement with a supportive community? We’ll inspire and empower you to deliver your best work so you can evolve, grow and succeed – today and into tomorrow. We offer an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive and diverse team who always strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities. People are our greatest asset, and we offer a competitive package to retain and attract the best talent. Our values stand on a foundation of safety, integrity, inclusion and diversity. We put people at the heart of our business, and we genuinely believe that we all succeed by supporting one another through our culture of caring. We value positive mental health and a sense of belonging for all employees. Amentum is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, please refer to our Enterprise Agreement and www.fairwork.gov.au for more information. Finance Director About The Opportunity Amentum has an exciting opportunity as our Finance Director. In this role, you’ll work with the local Leadership Team and oversee the Australian finance, payroll, project accounting and controls team. This role also has a reporting line into the Vice President Finance, based in the UK. The Role: Trusted Financial Partner to the Business, predominantly to Managing Director, Vice President Finance UK, Group Directors, Directors and to Corporate functions such as Accounting, Tax, Legal, Compliance and Corporate Financial Planning & Analysis. Leading and managing the finance, payroll, project accounting and controls team by providing support for career pathways, giving guidelines and advice, and reviewing of assigned tasks Supporting financial planning and forecasting processes by delivering timely, relevant and accurate weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual financial information for Australia, and subsequently into E&E International, including business trends Ensure all accounting treatments are in line with Australian accounting standards and recognise US GAAP/IFRS variances and required treatments. Have practical experience in Joint venture accounting and reporting. Provide clear and concise communication of results, forecasts and Risks & Opportunities for the business Ensure all local and international compliance (where required) for all Accounting/Finance and Taxation statutory requirements, such as Audited financial statements & lodgement, Payment Times Reporting, Australian End of Financial year lodgements plus others. Responsible for all financial audits internally and externally (to statutory authorities and clients) Work with the Commercial team to review and align standard business proposal pricing and manage (and conduct in some cases) complex pricing offerings to support business opportunities, and then operationalise pricing requirements if successful. Collaborate with MD and UK Finance Business Partners to FP&A Team to prepare regular and ad hoc reporting to the Business and to Corporate functions Ensure the business knows and understands the requirements of Corporate Reporting Devise and implement key performance indicator’s (KPI’s) which measure operational excellence alongside the delivery of financial goals Work with Operations team to understand the business trends, KPI’s and help facilitate, plan and operationalise improvements Focus on value add activities to maximise the profitability of the business and performance enhancement Enable the business to provide accurate forecasting and reporting with clear and educated understanding of the financials Support the business with Finance system updates, policies, procedures and any ERP updates as required. In addition, you will work internationally, with third parties and with Joint Venture initiatives Lead regular interaction with internal and external auditors and ensure best practice is implemented and maintained in line with company requirements, audit requirements, Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) and US GAAP Understand the activities, strategy, and market of the relevant business Liaise and advise overseas heads of finance to support compliance with wider Amentum processes Collaborate and advise on pricing policy, and open book audit requirements, including SSRO compliance Here's What You'll Need: We are looking for someone who can take initiative, drive positive change, bring enthusiasm, and apply effective communication skills across all levels of the organization. We need a strong leader and team player who excels in a collaborative environment but can also work proactively and independently with little direction. The ideal person will be an inspiring and agile leader with high integrity and openness combined with a commitment to thorough governance, outstanding ability to engage stakeholders and to develop appropriate partnerships, excellent time management skills to guide a complex workload, prioritize and set deadlines and cope with conflicting and changing requirements. The role reports directly to VP Finance. We are looking for the following skills: Qualified Accountant Many years of experience in senior financial roles, within large, diverse and commercially astute organisations Demonstrated record of achievement and the delivery of quality outcomes related to the management of the Finance Function Proven knowledge of relevant financial and tax management legislation, standards and regulatory requirements for Australia with knowledge of other international geographies (US) Knowledge of company director and company secretary requirements to support these positions where required. Willingness to work in a global team, with overlap with the UK/US where often required Excellent knowledge of English, both written and spoken If you’re the one, apply for it and grow with us!

efficiency, and craftsmanship Ability to support repeatable production fabrication processes Tools & Equipment Used Fabrication and fitting tools GMAW and FCAW-G welding equipment Measuring and layout tools Clamps, fixtures, and fabrication jigs Grinders and finishing equipment Saws and shop fabrication equipment Material handling equipment Hand and power tools Qualifications Minimum 3+ years of fabrication experience required Previous experience in structural or custom metal fabrication environments preferred Strong blueprint reading and layout interpretation skills Ability to work independently with minimal supervision Strong understanding of measurements, tolerances, and fabrication sequencing Ability to fit and weld complete assemblies Consistent quality and production output
